description:
Dear Team,

For the upcoming release we have locked the core libraries to specific versions to ensure stability across environments. The utility library lodash is fixed at version 4.17.21, our server framework express is pinned to version 4.18.2, and the UI library react is locked at version 18.2.0. Please verify that all development machines and CI pipelines are using these exact versions before proceeding with further integration work.
